title: Death of Krishna (Indian tradition)
summary: The death of Krishna, which Indian tradition makes the start of the Kali Age of the Mahabharata narrative; CFAH ties it to the year of Joshua's long day.
description: The death of Krishna, which Indian tradition makes the start of the Kali Age of the Mahabharata narrative; CFAH ties it to the year of Joshua's long day. Recorded from a CFAH OSF preprint anchor point (not yet published in ARJ). Added by the CFAH pass.
